text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Looking back on it. For some reason, 
it's always summer, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing major. Meeting you, too, 
was—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, receiving that wonderful "thesis"... 
Now that I think about it, that happened 
in the summer too...

I nod deeply. Come to think of it, it was 
always summer. When I first met Air 
Messiah, and when we forged our strong 
bond—

"...And to hear that important 'answer' 
straight from her lips."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I will go put away our luggage, so 
please wait just a little longer."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Once you return... by all means. Please, 
let us speak.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: About the "succession" that I can fulfill.

Her tail swayed in the summer breeze as I 
watched her run off into the distance.

The third summer since meeting Air 
Messiah. Once again, destiny sways 
alongside the scent of fresh greenery.

And so, after we casually made our way up 
to the hill overlooking the sea... she 
took a deep breath and began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, a lot of data... I mean, a 
lot of valuable lessons were learned.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, my answer... What I can 
carry on—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Nothing."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That is the answer.

I was so taken aback that I let out a 
shout. Air Messiah raised a brow slightly, 
then faintly softened her expression with 
an "Ah."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, that caused quite a 
misunderstanding. To be more precise—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "There is nothing special here."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—Simply, purely. Only 'things that ought 
to naturally exist' dwell here."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For instance, that would be "putting in 
effort."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Set a goal, assess one's own abilities... 
Consider what and how much needs to be 
built up, and execute.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
To get even a step closer to achieving her 
goal, she keeps sweating it out day after 
day.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, it is "fighting spirit." The 
will to step forth onto the stage of 
racing, of battle.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even when blocked by the wall of talent. 
Even when faced with an overwhelming 
presence.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even when crushed by hardship and brought 
to her knees at times, she stands up again 
and again, continuing to challenge. 
Continuing to run.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well, not to make it sound too grand, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Don't you think it's utterly... mundane?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, to a greater or lesser degree, 
isn't that true of all the girls here at 
Tracen Academy?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is putting in the effort. 
Everyone harbors a fighting spirit. 
Naturally, just as it ought to be.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why. What dwells within 
me is commonplace, not something special 
in the slightest—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"However, at any and all times, it will 
serve as a dependable strength."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us call that, for instance, "taking 
steps forward."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't vivid enough to say I dashed or 
ran through it with flying colors. It was 
neither glorious nor dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is plain, simple, and slow. Yet, step 
by step, solidly and steadily carved into 
the earth, it is undeniable progress.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I... No, we...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since my mother's time, we have continued 
down this path. That is precisely what I 
have etched into my soul.
choice_data_list:
Carrying on their "steps"... That is your 
inheritance――

Carrying on their "steps"... That is your 
inheritance――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Only supreme glory. This is a path seeking 
nothing but victory.

"Only victory." Her words carry a heavy 
weight that suddenly makes my chest 
tighten.
Right—that was it. She, they, had always—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it seems commonplace, that is 
precisely why everyone understands its 
true value."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A single-minded "stride forward" is noble 
in itself, and something worthy of praise.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Everyone will surely applaud you. "You 
fought well," "You worked hard," "Just 
watching you walk forward is already 
wonderful"—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"What our... what my strides are aiming 
for is not an effort award. Nor a fighting 
spirit prize."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I have continued to walk this path. Aiming 
for only one thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Toward victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Toward victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Toward victory!

Her voice and words ring out with dignity. 
...Even though she insists again and again 
that they are merely ordinary, that they 
are only natural.
choice_data_list: (Even so, the her right now is—)

text_block_list.text:
More special, beautiful, and noble than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—Which is why. I've kept you waiting a 
little, but...”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"If that is still what you desire... Then 
I shall pass on this 'power to move 
forward.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!! Yes, absolutely! Please!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to engrave it inside myself 
too. Your "path"... deeply!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san. Could we have a 
meeting regarding joint training?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd like you to leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, right—that's true. First of all, 
let me tell you this.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Blue Hairpin
text_block_list.text: ! A... Yes, what can I do for you!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"To meet someone who walks alongside me at 
the very same pace."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For me— that was the greatest turning 
point of all.

I instinctively stared toward her. Our 
eyes locked intently.

It was only at that moment that her eyes 
narrowed playfully, in a way she rarely 
ever showed.
